directAnswer: You can scan a QR code using your phone's camera app or a dedicated QR code scanning app. Most modern smartphones support QR code scanning directly through the camera without needing additional software.
summary: Scanning QR codes is a simple process that can be done using your smartphone's camera or a specific app, depending on your device.

sections.heading: Steps for Android Devices
sections.body: Most Android devices have built-in QR code scanning capabilities in the camera app.

sections.heading: Steps for iOS Devices
sections.body: iPhones have a built-in QR code reader in the Camera app, available from iOS 11 and later.

sections.heading: Troubleshooting Tips
sections.body: If your camera does not recognize the QR code, ensure the code is well-lit and in focus.

steps.title: Using the Camera App on Android
steps.detail: Open the Camera app, point it at the QR code, and tap the notification that appears to open the link.

steps.title: Using the Camera App on iOS
steps.detail: Open the Camera app, point it at the QR code, and a notification will pop up at the top of the screen. Tap it to access the content.

steps.title: Using a QR Code Scanner App
steps.detail: Download a QR code scanner app from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store, open the app, and follow the on-screen instructions.

faqs.question: What if my camera doesn't scan the QR code?
faqs.answer: Ensure the QR code is not damaged and is well-lit. Try moving closer or adjusting the angle.

faqs.question: Do I need an internet connection to scan a QR code?
faqs.answer: You do not need an internet connection to scan the QR code, but you will need it to access the content linked to the QR code.

faqs.question: Can I scan QR codes from my computer?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can use a QR code scanner app on your phone or a webcam with software that supports QR code scanning on your computer.

caveats: Some older devices may not have built-in QR code scanning capabilities and may require a third-party app.
